title: A Cellar for the Visitor
author: Felix Almeida
blurb: Yara Nystrom, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
